content.comment_body: Hello, What is the accuracy of the [product_name] internal clock over extended periods? If a [product_name] runs continuously for a year without synchronization, how much time drift should be expected? Has anyone tested this in practice?
According to the manual: The backup of the real-time clock at 25 °C is typically 20 days. The typical accuracy of the real-time clock is ± 2 seconds per day.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about the long-term accuracy and drift of the internal clock in [product_name] modules. Another user responded with official accuracy and backup specifications but did not share any real-world test results or experiences.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that the internal clock will maintain reliable timekeeping for long periods, without needing frequent synchronization or experiencing significant drift.
